hero.subtitle: Create beautifully branded, dynamic QR codes that connect your offline audience directly to your most critical digital assets. Track scans in real-time, just like you track clicks.
bulletPoints: Dynamic destination routing (change URLs after printing)
Fully customizable colors, shapes, and logos
Real-time geographic and device scan analytics

featuresInfo.title: Built for modern marketing teams
featuresInfo.subtitle: Stop throwing away printed materials because of a broken link. Dragolink QR codes are dynamic by default.

features.title: COMPLETE BRAND CUSTOMIZATION TEST
features.description: Align your QR codes perfectly with your brand guidelines. Customize the patterns, corner eyes, colors, and embed your own logo in the center.

features.title: Dynamic Routing
features.description: Update the destination URL of your QR code at any time, even after it's been printed on thousands of flyers, billboards, or product packages.

features.title: Granular Scan Analytics
features.description: See exactly when and where your QR codes are being scanned. Track cities, countries, device types, and operating systems in real time.

features.title: Print-Ready Exports
features.description: Download your QR codes in high-resolution PNG, SVG, or EPS formats, ensuring crisp, scannable codes at any physical size.

features.title: Geo-Targeting
features.description: Route users to different destination URLs based on the country or city they are scanning the QR code from.

features.title: Enterprise Security
features.description: Secure your QR codes with password protection or SSO walls, ensuring sensitive documents are only accessible to authorized personnel.

useCasesInfo.title: Endless possibilities
useCasesInfo.subtitle: See how leading brands are leveraging Dragolink QR codes to drive offline engagement.

useCases.label: Retail & CPG Packaging
useCases.desc: Place dynamic QR codes on product packaging to route customers to instruction manuals, warranty registration, or loyalty programs.

useCases.label: Direct Mail Campaigns
useCases.desc: Track the exact ROI of your direct mailers by measuring geographic scan data and tying it back to regional sales performance.

useCases.label: Event Badges & Ticketing
useCases.desc: Enable seamless check-ins, contact sharing, and session tracking at live events with individualized, scannable QR codes.

useCases.label: Restaurant Menus & Ordering
useCases.desc: Update your menu instantly without reprinting. Route customers directly to your online ordering system or digital wine list.
